The A2A protocol allows AI agents to communicate with each other, securely exchange information, and coordinate actions on top of various enterprise platforms or applications. - Capability discovery: Agents can advertise their capabilities using an "Agent Card" in JSON format, allowing the client agent to identify the best agent that can perform a task
